summary.name: ProWritingAid
summary.one_liner: ProWritingAid is a writing toolkit for storytellers that covers planning, drafting habits, story critique, editing, and publishing guidance.
use_cases: Editing and polishing a book draft
Navigating options for publishing a book
summary.what_it_does: The page describes planning tools for shaping story ideas, writing tools for building a routine, and a Story Critique feature that identifies what is holding a story back. Editing tools are offered to polish manuscripts. It also mentions publishing guidance and a community of writers. The page says the features can be accessed inside the user's writing app of choice. It states that some features use assistive AI but that the tool will not write the user's words.
notable: Story Critique feature for fiction revision feedback
Planning, writing habit, and mindset tools framed as the ProWritingMethod
Works inside the user's writing app of choice
Uses assistive AI but states it will not write the user's words
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform availability beyond the web is not specified on the page
